usage.notes: Server-backed client. ASC SKU usage-client-monitor. Self-host free server code. Bundle ID is com.simplewithus.usage.client.ios (2026-10-09 scheme; supersedes the 2026-09-23 suffix omission; was services.jays.usage.client.monitor, then com.simplewithus.usagemonitor.ios). appleId is null on purpose: the old Apple ID belongs to the services.jays.usage.client.monitor record and cannot be moved to a new bundle ID. A new App Store Connect record for com.simplewithus.usage.client.ios is pending (owner step); the widget is an extension and has no separate App Store Connect record. ship-testflight.sh refuses this key while ascRecordPending is true.
